about: Inkling 2 Mini (26B looped MoE, thinking) unsloth UD-Q2_K_XL (mainline-compatible file) on one 8 GB RTX 5050, 65,536-token window, text only. Engine: realugbun/llama.cpp inkling2-speed plus two patches, pinned at andyguzmaneth/llama.cpp@6b85c8e: llama.cpp #32740 (compact relative-position bias in flash attention, by pwilkin) and gravy-zeppelin's host-expert offload fixes (dan-el-7/gravy-zeppelin patch 04). #32740 is the big one on 8 GB: without it Inkling materializes its per-head attention bias, a 1.6 GB compute buffer at -ub 128 and 6.5 GB at -ub 512. With it, all twelve looped layers (6-17) fit their experts on the GPU, and only the experts of ten once-run layers (0-5, 18-21) stay in host RAM. Prompts stream those host experts to the GPU in -ub 512 batches (op-offload on, --no-repack), which doubles prefill (405 to 831 tok/s at 4K) with no decode cost; decode still runs host experts on the CPU. --override-kv expert_used_count=6 (of 8): +6% decode over 7 experts on this card; hard MATH-500 level 4-5 29/30 on two runs (the 8-expert setup also scored 29/30), GSM8K 40/40. Measured with no gain or a loss on this card: --cpu-strict 1 --prio 2 (-15%), q4_0 V cache (decode at 47K 37 to 23.5), -t 12, whole once-run layers on CPU including attention (-30%), loop.count 2 (+23% decode but answers ramble to the token cap), --reasoning-budget 256 (MATH 29/30 to 20/30), DSpark speculation (verifying 4 tokens costs 2.5x one with host experts). Host: Ryzen 9 9900X VM, 16 vCPU, 20 GB RAM (65 GB/s measured read bandwidth), model mmapped from NVMe.
install: git clone -b inkling2-speed-gz https://github.com/andyguzmaneth/llama.cpp llama.cpp-inkling2-speed-gz && git -C llama.cpp-inkling2-speed-gz checkout 6b85c8e12d78c5d73943df77fe40dd44bd6330ef && cmake -S llama.cpp-inkling2-speed-gz -B llama.cpp-inkling2-speed-gz/build -DGGML_CUDA=ON -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=120 -DLLAMA_CURL=OFF -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build llama.cpp-inkling2-speed-gz/build --target llama-server -j
setup: Not Docker; Linux x86-64, NVIDIA driver for CUDA 12.8+, CUDA 12.8 nvcc and cuBLAS dev packages to build. Build from the pinned commit (install), run from the directory that holds llama.cpp-inkling2-speed-gz/ and models/.
